title: Isandro and the Signal
author: Tamsin Okonkwo
blurb: Ines Oyelaran, a clone who inherited the original's murder case, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. Then an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise before the fleet's truce expires.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
